note: Recorded live qwen3.8-max/flash NDJSON streams from 2026-10-30. lineTimes = [ms since request start, raw line]. Follow-ups (B*) were sent with baseState as CURRENT DIAGRAM. Product ids use the probe mini catalog (underscored ids such as anti_ddos, model_studio), not catalog v0 ids.
